port.ask: Serial port the pump's RS-232 connector is cabled to (COM9, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.usbserial-*)
port.help: The pump's RS-232 ribbon/DB-9 connector to a PC serial port or USB-serial adapter; RS-485 needs an adapter.

syringe_ul.ask: Volume of the fitted syringe in microlitres (printed on the syringe barrel)
syringe_ul.help: The driver converts every volume_ul to plunger increments from this number; a wrong value moves the wrong volume.

steps_full_stroke.ask: Plunger increments per full stroke: 6000 for an XLP 6000 in standard mode (48000 in fine mode), 3000 for an XCalibur

baud.ask: Baud rate (9600 default; 38400 if set on the pump with U47)
